sources.paraphrase: After the branching route, a lantern puzzle requires clearing small rocks, carrying a torch and lighting the standing lanterns. A final monster precedes the exit.

observations.description: Portable gray brazier lies in the room with the orange barrier and unlit standing lanterns.
Actor carries the gray brazier overhead; the interact button shows a throw arrow. A standing flame source is already lit.
Carried brazier burns; lower right standing lantern is lit. A neighboring green rock is burning.
Actor has crossed the barrier and faces an Orc Warrior.

limitation: Guide observations are not current-account interaction or stage-clear evidence.
